senses.en: to show too much respect or obedience to someone in order to please them

example.en: He refused to kowtow to his demanding boss.
example.zh: 他拒绝向苛刻的老板卑躬屈膝。

senses.en: to kneel and touch the ground with the forehead as a traditional sign of respect

example.en: In imperial times, officials had to kowtow before the emperor.
example.zh: 在帝制时代，官员必须在皇帝面前磕头。

senses.en: a metric unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams; one kilogram

example.en: The parcel weighs five kilogrammes.
example.zh: 这个包裹重五公斤。

senses.en: the process of turning a liquid into vapour

example.en: Vaporization occurs faster at higher temperatures.
example.zh: 温度越高，蒸发越快。

senses.en: complete destruction, as if by turning into vapour

example.en: The explosion threatened the vaporization of the entire building.
example.zh: 爆炸可能使整栋楼化为乌有。

senses.en: able to be mended or fixed

example.en: The damage to the car turned out to be repairable.
example.zh: 汽车的损坏结果是可以修复的。

senses.en: in a deep, rough, or husky voice

example.en: He laughed throatily at the joke.
example.zh: 听到这个笑话他沙哑地笑了。

senses.en: a person who believes one race is better than others

example.en: The organisation refused to work with people who are racists.
example.zh: 该组织拒绝与种族主义者共事。

senses.en: based on unfair treatment of people because of their race
senses.zh: 种族主义的，种族歧视的

example.en: The company has a policy against racist remarks at work.
example.zh: 公司有禁止工作中发表种族主义言论的规定。

senses.en: relating to the nose

example.en: She suffered from nasal congestion due to a cold.
example.zh: 她因感冒而鼻塞。

senses.en: sounding as if the voice comes through the nose

example.en: He spoke in a nasal voice because of his cold.
example.zh: 他因为感冒说话带着鼻音。

senses.en: a speech sound produced through the nose, such as /m/ or /n/

example.en: French uses more nasal vowels than English.
example.zh: 法语比英语使用更多鼻化元音。

senses.en: to appear again after being gone or hidden

example.en: The sun reappeared from behind the clouds.
example.zh: 太阳从云层后面重新露了出来。

senses.en: the medical science that studies diseases and their causes and effects

example.en: She teaches pathology at the medical school.
example.zh: 她在医学院教病理学。

senses.en: a disease or abnormal condition

example.en: The scan revealed a small pathology in the lung.
example.zh: 扫描发现肺部有一处小病变。

senses.en: a legal case brought to a court to settle a dispute

example.en: She filed a lawsuit against her former employer.
example.zh: 她对前雇主提起了诉讼。

senses.en: to make someone feel admiration or respect
senses.zh: 使钦佩；给…留下深刻印象

example.en: The young pianist impressed everyone at the concert.
example.zh: 这位年轻钢琴家在音乐会上给所有人留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: to press a mark, design, or words into a surface or onto an object

example.en: The machine impresses a serial number onto each metal plate.
example.zh: 这台机器在每块金属板上压印一个序列号。

senses.en: to make someone understand that something is important

example.en: She impressed on the team the need for careful record-keeping.
example.zh: 她向团队强调认真做好记录的必要性。

senses.en: to look steadily at someone or something for a long time

example.en: They stood on the hill and gazed at the sunset.
example.zh: 他们站在山上凝视着日落。

senses.en: a long, steady look

example.en: She held his gaze for a moment.
example.zh: 她与他对视了片刻。

senses.en: an indirect or subtle suggestion

example.en: She gave me a hint that she wanted to leave early.
example.zh: 她暗示我她想早点离开。

senses.en: a small amount or slight trace

example.en: There was a hint of a smile on his face.
example.zh: 他脸上露出一丝微笑。

senses.en: to suggest something indirectly

example.en: He hinted that the price might drop soon.
example.zh: 他暗示价格可能很快会下降。

senses.en: something that happens, especially something important or noticeable

example.en: The opening of the new library was a major event for the town.
example.zh: 新图书馆的开馆对该镇来说是一件大事。

senses.en: a planned public or social occasion

example.en: The school holds a sports event every spring.
example.zh: 学校每年春天举办一场体育活动。

senses.en: one of the races or competitions in a sports programme

example.en: She won the 100-metre event at the regional championships.
example.zh: 她在地区锦标赛上赢得了100米比赛。

senses.en: A person who teaches or does research at a college or university.
senses.zh: 大学教师；高校科研人员；学者

example.en: She is a respected academic at a public university.
example.zh: 她是一所公立大学里受人尊敬的学者。

senses.en: Relating to education, study, or research, especially at a college or university.

example.en: The library supports academic research across many fields.
example.zh: 图书馆支持多个领域的学术研究。

senses.en: Existing only in theory and not expected to have an immediate practical result.

example.en: Whether the plan will work is an academic question until funding is approved.
example.zh: 在资金获批之前，该计划是否可行只是一个理论问题。

senses.en: the act of putting thoughts or feelings into words, art, or actions

example.en: She gave a clear expression of her concerns.
example.zh: 她清楚地表达了自己的担忧。

senses.en: the look on a person's face that shows a feeling

example.en: His expression changed when he heard the news.
example.zh: 他听到这个消息时表情变了。

senses.en: a word or phrase used to convey an idea

example.en: The expression "break the ice" is common in English.
example.zh: “break the ice”这个短语在英语中很常见。

senses.en: money paid for a service or for permission to do something

example.en: The entrance fee is ten dollars.
example.zh: 入场费是十美元。

senses.en: a strong metal made from iron and carbon, used to make tools, buildings and machines
senses.zh: 钢，钢铁；由铁和碳制成的坚硬金属，用于制造工具、建筑和机器

example.en: The bridge is made of steel.
example.zh: 这座桥是用钢制成的。

senses.en: to make yourself mentally ready for something difficult or unpleasant
senses.zh: 使坚强；使做好准备（面对困难或不快）

example.en: She steeled herself for the bad news.
example.zh: 她做好了面对坏消息的心理准备。

senses.en: to move smoothly over a surface, often by accident or without control

example.en: The box slid across the floor when he pushed it.
example.zh: 他推了一下，箱子便滑过地板。

senses.en: a small flat piece of glass used to hold specimens for a microscope

example.en: The lab technician placed the specimen on a glass slide.
example.zh: 实验室技术员把标本放在玻璃载玻片上。

senses.en: a single page or image in a presentation

example.en: She added a chart to the final slide.
example.zh: 她在最后一张幻灯片上添加了图表。

senses.en: not mixed with anything else and free from dirt or harmful substances
senses.zh: 纯的；纯净的；无有害杂质的

example.en: The water in the lake is pure enough to drink.
example.zh: 湖里的水纯净得可以饮用。

senses.en: complete and nothing else; used to emphasize a quality or feeling

example.en: It was pure luck that we found the place.
example.zh: 我们找到那个地方纯属运气。

senses.en: morally clean and without bad intentions

example.en: She led a pure life, free from deceit.
example.zh: 她过着纯洁的生活，远离欺骗。

senses.en: the second planet from the sun, visible from Earth as a bright 'morning star' or 'evening star'

example.en: Venus is the brightest planet in our solar system.
example.zh: 金星是太阳系中最明亮的行星。

senses.en: the Roman goddess of love and beauty
senses.zh: 维纳斯（罗马神话中的爱与美之神）

example.en: The statue of Venus is one of the most famous works of ancient art.
example.zh: 维纳斯雕像是古代艺术最著名的作品之一。

senses.en: a standard for measuring or assessing something

example.en: Customer satisfaction is an important metric for the company.
example.zh: 客户满意度是公司的一项重要指标。

senses.en: relating to the metric system of measurement based on meters and kilograms

example.en: The recipe gives measurements in metric units.
example.zh: 这个食谱以公制单位给出用量。

senses.en: expressing ideas clearly, fluently and effectively; persuasive
senses.zh: 雄辩的；有说服力的；生动的

example.en: She gave an eloquent speech that moved the whole audience.
example.zh: 她发表了一场感动全场听众的雄辩演说。

senses.en: a tool or implement used for practical tasks, especially in the kitchen or household

example.en: Please wash the cooking utensils after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后请把炊具洗干净。

senses.en: a small bottle with a narrow neck, used for liquids

example.en: She poured water from the flask into a glass.
example.zh: 她把水从瓶子里倒进杯子。

senses.en: a small flat bottle for carrying liquor in a pocket

example.en: He carried a hip flask on long hikes.
example.zh: 他长途徒步时随身带一个扁酒壶。

senses.en: a container used in laboratories for heating or mixing liquids

example.en: The chemist heated the solution in a flask.
example.zh: 化学家在烧瓶中加热溶液。

senses.en: feeling or showing strong hatred

example.en: He posted hateful comments online.
example.zh: 他在网上发表了充满仇恨的评论。

senses.en: deserving or likely to cause hatred; very unpleasant

example.en: The weather was hateful that week.
example.zh: 那个星期的天气令人讨厌。

senses.en: an official examination of a company's financial records

example.en: The company passed its annual audit.
example.zh: 该公司通过了年度审计。

senses.en: to officially examine financial records, or to sit in on a course without credit

example.en: An outside firm will audit the accounts.
example.zh: 一家外部机构将审计这些账目。

senses.en: the British royal family (since 1917); also a town west of London with a famous castle
senses.zh: 温莎（英国王室名；伦敦以西有著名城堡的城镇）

example.en: Windsor Castle is one of the official residences of the British monarch.
example.zh: 温莎城堡是英国君主的官邸之一。

senses.en: a city in southeastern Ontario, Canada, opposite Detroit
senses.zh: 温莎（加拿大安大略省东南部城市）

example.en: Windsor, Ontario lies across the river from Detroit.
example.zh: 安大略省温莎市与底特律隔河相望。

senses.en: an official limit on the amount of something allowed

example.en: The country set an import quota on cars.
example.zh: 该国对汽车进口设定了配额。

senses.en: a required or assigned share of work or sales

example.en: Salespeople must reach their monthly quota.
example.zh: 销售人员必须完成每月的定额。

senses.en: to give someone the authority or power to do something

example.en: The new law empowers local governments to set their own rules.
example.zh: 新法律授权地方政府制定自己的规则。

senses.en: to make someone stronger and more confident

example.en: Education can empower people to change their lives.
example.zh: 教育能让人有能力改变自己的生活。

senses.en: to make something or someone fresh or cleaner

example.en: She freshened up before the meeting.
example.zh: 她在会议前梳洗了一下。

senses.en: (of wind or weather) to become stronger or colder

example.en: The wind began to freshen in the evening.
example.zh: 傍晚时分风开始变强了。

senses.en: not thinking about other people's feelings

example.en: It was thoughtless of him to forget her birthday.
example.zh: 他忘了她的生日，太不体贴了。

senses.en: done without careful thinking

example.en: That was a thoughtless decision made in a hurry.
example.zh: 那是匆忙中做出的轻率决定。

senses.en: the act of fighting; physical combat or struggle

example.en: The fighting continued for several days before a truce was agreed.
example.zh: 停火达成之前，战斗持续了好几天。

senses.en: engaged in or ready for combat; fit for fighting
senses.zh: 战斗的；好斗的；适于作战的

example.en: The soldiers were sent to the fighting front immediately.
example.zh: 士兵们被立即派往战斗前线。

senses.en: a male given name of Welsh origin

example.en: Owen is coming to visit us next weekend.
example.zh: 欧文下周末要来看我们。

senses.en: living simply and avoiding pleasure for religious or spiritual reasons

example.en: He led an ascetic life with few possessions.
example.zh: 他过着几乎没有财产的苦行生活。

senses.en: a person who lives a simple, self-denying life for religious reasons

example.en: The ascetic spent years meditating alone in the mountains.
example.zh: 那位苦行者独自在山里冥想多年。

senses.en: extreme cruelty or violent behavior

example.en: The report described the savagery of the conflict.
example.zh: 报道描述了那场冲突的残暴。

senses.en: a wild or primitive state

example.en: The novel depicts characters regressing into savagery.
example.zh: 这部小说描绘了人物退化回野蛮状态的过程。

senses.en: the belief that God or gods do not exist, or lack of belief in them

example.en: His atheism made him question many traditional customs.
example.zh: 他的无神论使他质疑许多传统习俗。

senses.en: acceptable, fine, or satisfactory (informal spelling of "all right")

example.en: Is it alright if I borrow your pen?
example.zh: 我借用一下你的笔可以吗？

senses.en: well or satisfactorily; used to confirm something (informal)

example.en: Don't worry, everything will turn out alright.
example.zh: 别担心，一切都会没事的。

senses.en: the state of being unknown or not important

example.en: The singer rose from obscurity to fame.
example.zh: 这位歌手从默默无闻到声名鹊起。

senses.en: the quality of being difficult to understand

example.en: The essay is criticized for its obscurity.
example.zh: 这篇文章因晦涩难懂而受到批评。

senses.en: a light, creamy dessert made with whipped cream and egg whites

example.en: We had chocolate mousse for dessert.
example.zh: 我们甜点吃了巧克力慕斯。

senses.en: a foamy styling product for the hair

example.en: She applied some mousse before blow-drying her hair.
example.zh: 她吹干头发前抹了些摩丝。

senses.en: to let saliva flow from the mouth

example.en: The baby drooled onto his shirt.
example.zh: 婴儿的口水滴到了衬衫上。

senses.en: to show great eagerness or desire for something

example.en: Fans drooled over the new sports car.
example.zh: 车迷们对这辆新跑车垂涎欲滴。

senses.en: saliva that flows from the mouth

example.en: Wipe the drool off the baby's chin.
example.zh: 把婴儿下巴上的口水擦掉。

senses.en: an idea or opinion produced by thinking

example.en: That is an interesting thought.
example.zh: 那是个有趣的想法。

senses.en: the act or process of thinking

example.en: She was deep in thought.
example.zh: 她陷入深思。

senses.en: careful consideration of something

example.en: Please give the proposal some thought.
example.zh: 请考虑一下这个提议。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of think
senses.zh: think 的过去式和过去分词

example.en: I thought you knew.
example.zh: 我以为你知道。

senses.en: used before a plural noun to refer to people or things that are near or have just been mentioned
senses.zh: 这些（用于复数名词前，指附近或刚提到的人或事物）

example.en: These shoes are too tight.
example.zh: 这些鞋太紧了。

senses.en: used to refer to plural people or things that are near or have just been mentioned
senses.zh: 这些（指附近或刚提到的复数人或事物）

example.en: I prefer these to the others.
example.zh: 比起其他的，我更喜欢这些。

senses.en: a large natural hole in rock or ground, often in a hill or cliff

example.en: We found shelter in a small cave during the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨中我们在一个小山洞里找到了庇护。

senses.en: to give in under pressure or threat

example.en: The manager finally caved and accepted our plan.
example.zh: 经理最终让步，接受了我们的方案。

senses.en: an illness that affects people, animals, or plants

example.en: The disease spreads through contaminated water.
example.zh: 这种疾病通过受污染的水传播。

senses.en: a particular illness with specific signs or symptoms

example.en: Doctors are studying a rare disease of the nervous system.
example.zh: 医生正在研究一种罕见的神经系统疾病。

senses.en: touching or supported by something

example.en: The book is on the table.
example.zh: 书在桌子上。

senses.en: about or concerning something

example.en: She wrote a book on climate change.
example.zh: 她写了一本关于气候变化的书。

senses.en: in operation or functioning

example.en: Please leave the lights on.
example.zh: 请让灯亮着。

senses.en: used to say the day or date when something happens

example.en: The class starts on Monday.
example.zh: 课程周一开始。

senses.en: a warm bed covering made of stitched layers of fabric with soft filling

example.en: She pulled the quilt up to keep warm on the cold night.
example.zh: 寒冷的夜里，她拉过被子取暖。

senses.en: to stitch or sew layers of fabric together, often with soft filling in between

example.en: My grandmother quilted a blanket by hand.
example.zh: 我祖母手工缝制了一条被子。

senses.en: next to or near something else

example.en: The hotel is adjacent to the train station.
example.zh: 酒店紧邻火车站。

senses.en: neatly arranged or organized; well-behaved and without trouble

example.en: The files are kept in an orderly manner.
example.zh: 文件被保存得井井有条。

senses.en: a hospital worker who does general, non-medical tasks

example.en: An orderly helped move the patient to another room.
example.zh: 一位护理员帮忙把病人转移到另一个房间。

senses.en: a soldier assigned to serve an officer or do routine military duties

example.en: The officer sent his orderly with a message.
example.zh: 军官派他的勤务兵去送信。

senses.en: kind, polite, and generous in manner

example.en: She was gracious enough to thank every guest personally.
example.zh: 她亲切地亲自向每位客人道谢。

senses.en: elegant, comfortable, and showing good taste

example.en: They live in a gracious old house in the countryside.
example.zh: 他们住在乡下一栋雅致的老房子里。

senses.en: to exist in large quantities

example.en: Fish abound in this lake.
example.zh: 这个湖里鱼很多。

senses.en: to have a great amount of something (abound in/with)

example.en: The region abounds in wildlife.
example.zh: 该地区野生动物资源丰富。

senses.en: a movie theater

example.en: We watched a new film at the cinema last night.
example.zh: 我们昨晚在电影院看了一部新电影。

senses.en: the art and industry of making films

example.en: She has spent her whole career working in cinema.
example.zh: 她的整个职业生涯都从事电影行业。

senses.en: no longer used or useful because something newer exists

example.en: Typewriters have become almost obsolete.
example.zh: 打字机几乎已经被淘汰了。

senses.en: to officially decide that someone is not guilty of a crime

example.en: The jury acquitted the defendant after only two hours of discussion.
example.zh: 陪审团经过仅仅两小时的讨论就宣判被告无罪。

senses.en: to behave or perform in a particular way

example.en: The young player acquitted himself well in his first international match.
example.zh: 这位年轻球员在首场国际比赛中表现出色。

senses.en: to make something completely clean

example.en: Cleanse your face before applying moisturizer.
example.zh: 涂抹保湿霜前请先清洁面部。

senses.en: to rid a place or person of something bad or unwanted

example.en: The reform was meant to cleanse the organization of corruption.
example.zh: 这次改革旨在清除组织中的腐败。

senses.en: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties

example.en: Her resilience helped her rebuild after the disaster.
example.zh: 她的韧性帮助她在灾难后重建生活。

senses.en: the ability of a material to return to its original shape after bending or stretching

example.en: Rubber is prized for its resilience.
example.zh: 橡胶因其弹性而受到重视。

senses.en: a liquid that can dissolve other substances

example.en: Water is a common solvent used in labs.
example.zh: 水是实验室常用的溶剂。

senses.en: having enough money to pay all debts

example.en: The company stayed solvent despite the recession.
example.zh: 尽管经济衰退，公司仍保持偿付能力。

senses.en: the process of purifying a liquid by boiling and condensing its vapor

example.en: Perfume oils are often extracted by distillation.
example.zh: 香水精油常通过蒸馏提取。

senses.en: a distilled liquid, such as spirits

example.en: This whisky is a fine distillation of aged malt.
example.zh: 这款威士忌是陈年麦芽的优质蒸馏产物。

senses.en: relating to the study or interpretation of images and symbols
senses.zh: 图像学的；与图像表现有关的

example.en: The book analyzes the iconographic meaning of medieval paintings.
example.zh: 这本书分析了中世纪绘画的图像学含义。

senses.en: the scientific study of the oceans

example.en: She studied oceanography to learn about ocean currents.
example.zh: 她学习海洋学以了解洋流。

senses.en: to block or deflect a blow or attack

example.en: The fencer parried his opponent's thrust with ease.
example.zh: 击剑手轻松挡开了对手的刺击。

senses.en: to avoid answering a question or dealing with an issue

example.en: The minister cleverly parried questions about the budget.
example.zh: 部长巧妙地回避了关于预算的问题。

senses.en: a blocking movement, especially in fencing

example.en: His quick parry saved him from the punch.
example.zh: 他迅速的闪避使他躲过了那一拳。

senses.en: to shine light on something or treat it with radiation

example.en: Food is often irradiated to extend its shelf life.
example.zh: 食品常经辐照以延长保质期。

senses.en: to avoid a rule or problem by finding a clever way around it

example.en: The company tried to circumvent the new regulations.
example.zh: 该公司试图规避新规定。

senses.en: to go around something, especially an obstacle

example.en: They circumvented the blocked road by taking a side street.
example.zh: 他们绕过封路的道路，走了旁边的小街。

senses.en: to divide people into two groups with completely opposite views

example.en: The election polarized the country.
example.zh: 这场选举使国家两极分化。

senses.en: to make light waves vibrate in one direction only

example.en: Sunglasses polarize light to reduce glare.
example.zh: 太阳镜使光偏振以减少眩光。

senses.en: including or found in many parts of the world; not limited to one country

example.en: New York is a truly cosmopolitan city with people from all over the world.
example.zh: 纽约是一座真正的国际大都市，居民来自世界各地。

senses.en: having wide experience of many countries and cultures
senses.zh: 见识广博的；四海为家的

example.en: She has a cosmopolitan outlook after years of working abroad.
example.zh: 多年在国外工作后，她有着开放的国际视野。

senses.en: a person who is at home in many countries and cultures
senses.zh: 世界主义者；四海为家的人

example.en: As a cosmopolitan, he feels comfortable in any major city.
example.zh: 作为一个世界主义者，他在任何大城市都感到自在。

senses.en: an arranged meeting at a particular time and place

example.en: Our rendezvous is at the train station at noon.
example.zh: 我们约定中午在火车站会面。

senses.en: a place where people regularly meet

example.en: The café is a popular rendezvous for students.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆是学生们常去的聚会地点。

senses.en: to meet at an agreed time and place

example.en: The two boats rendezvoused near the island.
example.zh: 两艘船在岛屿附近会合。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving on skates

example.en: We went skating on the frozen lake.
example.zh: 我们去结冰的湖面上滑冰了。

senses.en: a substance produced and released by a gland or cell in the body

example.en: Saliva is a secretion that helps with digestion.
example.zh: 唾液是一种有助于消化的分泌物。

senses.en: the process by which a gland or cell produces and releases a substance

example.en: Hormone secretion is regulated by the brain.
example.zh: 激素的分泌受大脑调节。

senses.en: polite and proper behavior

example.en: The students showed great decorum during the ceremony.
example.zh: 学生们在典礼上表现得非常得体。

senses.en: able to provide for your own needs without help from others

example.en: The farm is self-sufficient, producing all its own food.
example.zh: 这个农场自给自足，所有的食物都是自己生产的。
